text:
lia: uploaded two small prototypes for the streaming toolbar: Prototype A uses 'Pause' + 'Stop' (Pause freezes stream and can resume), Prototype B uses a single 'Stop' with a separate 'Resume' affordance only after a Stop. PNGs attached. quick takes?

dan: i lean Pause. users who read long outputs want to freeze without losing the partial text. Resume is nice for iterative reading.

kevin: pause semantics matter for infra. if Pause keeps the model session/KV alive we bill/keep resources. can we make Pause a UI-only pause (pause rendering only) vs server-side pause? need a clear tooltip.

maria: UX concern: token counter behavior while paused. i suggest freeze the live counter but show "paused at 212 / 4096" plus a dimmed sparkline to indicate rate before pause. also include keyboard shortcut 'P' for pause/resume and Esc for stop.

jon: micro-animation note: token badge jumps when updated per chunk. instead of discrete jumps use a 150ms ease on the left digit and show the static limit on the right (e.g., "212 / 4096"). small sparkline for tokens/sec is a nice signal for streaming speed.

accessibility-bot: accessibility notes: 1) Pause/Resume control should use aria-pressed to expose toggle state. 2) When paused, set streaming container aria-live="off" to avoid continuous announcements; when resumed switch back to aria-live="polite". 3) provide aria-labels: aria-label="Pause stream (press P)" and aria-label="Stop generation (Esc)".

tasha: infra reality check: if Pause is server-side (holds session), we need heartbeat and eviction TTL. that increases cost on hosted. recommendation: ship Pause off by default for hosted; enable via feature flag for Dedicated where customers expect session control. if UI-only Pause we avoid server cost but must be clear in tooltip.

kevin: copy nit: label 'Pause' is okay; avoid 'Interrupt' which confuses. Tooltip text: "Pause rendering; server task will continue" or "Pause rendering; server task paused (Dedicated only)" depending on mode.

maria: prompt library placement: push the chat column on desktop so token meter stays visible; overlay on mobile. when pushing, ensure pinned-bottom behavior for active stream is preserved (scroll anchor).

lia: decision proposal: Default to Stop-only for hosted, expose Pause behind a Dedicated feature flag. Implement UI-only Pause in the interim for experiments. Both variants should throttle token badge updates to 200ms and animate the left number. Add token-sparkline as optional micro-component.

jon: telemetry requests: track ui.control=stop|pause, pause_duration_ms, resumed=true|false, token_update_emitted. include experiment tag when feature-flagged.

kevin: i'll add component props: allowPause: boolean, pauseMode: "ui-only"|"server", tokenUpdateThrottleMs: "200", showSparkline: boolean.

lia: action items: i'll update mocks (include aria attributes and sparkline), file the feature-flag ticket, add keyboard shortcut docs, and draft an a11y checklist. tagging eng and design for review.

ops-bot: heads-up: staging rollout including streaming-client patch scheduled Wednesday 14:00 UTC; feature flags available for canary teams.

lia: thanks everyone 44d I'll attach mocks and acceptance criteria to the ticket.
